title: Jappa Retry
description: A Combination of Minecraft's Modern and Old textures!
body:
![A black box that contains text in the center with the style of Undertale's logo saying: JAPPA SWAP, A Minecraft AU.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ba66ad5143ea6771484473e301ee44a7db6eaa8.png)
# Just kidding! It isn't called JappaSwap... plz....

Welcome to my awesome brand new Awesome resource pack, Jappa Retry!

Yadda yadda yadda!\
This is an epic freakinge combination of Modern and Old textures ! 1.14 and Pre-1.14 ! Le Modernos and Nostalgia Retros! You name it, I made it!

This Pack is Currently in Development and the version posted is like. Most Likely an public In-Development version. somethin around those lines. Anyways...

**Currently only supports 1.12.4** and will have **Optional features with The CEM Mod** (Custom Entity Models) In The Future

Credits are in the Read Me file in the Pack!!!

Submit Ideas n Crape in the Discord Server i guess!!!

**ADDITIONAL FRIGGIN INFO:**\
I like how these packs mesh together with This pack ! Consider downloadin them too for.. The Ultimate Experience?\
